verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The yellow highlight bars have come away from the headline and float on the photo with nothing behind them. 'BEST TRX' sits on the bottom edge of the photo. 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' and 'FREYA ANOUK' are pulled about 130px apart, with a large empty white area around and below them, and the whole lower half feels unplanned. A's lower half is bare white with almost no brand yellow. B adds a tall yellow bar at bottom right that touches the label boxes, like the yellow frame behind the labels in the original. It still looks arbitrary, but it brings back some brand colour and fills a little of the empty space, so B is slightly less bad.
